answer.reason: Zobah is a region whose king Hadadezer was defeated by David, and whose men were hired by Ammon against Israel.

clauses.english: saw its king Hadadezer defeated by David, who took chariots, horsemen and footmen from him
clauses.quote: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah

clauses.english: sent hired footmen to fight for Ammon against David's host under Joab
clauses.quote: hired the Syrians of Bethrehob and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen

doubts: 1SA 14:47 (Saul fought the kings of Zobah) was left out as a bare mention beside other enemies.
2SA 23:36 and 1CH 11:47 name a man of Zobah in a list of warriors, and Rezon's flight (1KI 11:23-24) concerns Rezon more than the region, so these were left out.
PSA 60:1 is a title mention only.
